summary: As of mid-2026, the LLM landscape is dominated by ChatGPT/GPT-5 in consumer web traffic (53.9% share) while enterprise API usage has shifted significantly toward Anthropic's Claude (40% of enterprise API spend). The open-source segment has matured rapidly, with Meta Llama 4, DeepSeek V4-Pro, and Qwen3 now matching closed frontier models on coding benchmarks, dramatically lowering barriers for self-hosted deployment. Aggregator reach through AWS Bedrock, Azure OpenAI, Google Vertex AI, and Snowflake Cortex has become a critical adoption multiplier, particularly benefiting Claude, Gemini, and Llama in regulated enterprise environments.

models.name: GPT-5 / GPT-5.1
models.popularity_notes: Holds 53.9% of worldwide AI chatbot web-visit share as of May 2026 and leads all LLM API providers per Future AGI rankings, with broad availability on Azure OpenAI Service, AWS Bedrock, and Google Vertex AI amplifying enterprise reach far beyond direct API numbers.
strengths: Largest developer mindshare and ecosystem
Top-tier multi-step reasoning and conversational depth
Widest aggregator coverage (Azure, AWS, Vertex)
Strong function-calling and tool-use capabilities
Extensive third-party integrations and SDKs
models.best_for: General-purpose enterprise applications, conversational AI, complex reasoning pipelines

models.name: Claude Opus 5 / Claude Fable 5.1
models.popularity_notes: Commands 40% of enterprise API spend per Menlo Ventures 2025 data, reached 952.6 million monthly web visits in May 2026 (up 855% YoY), and Claude Fable 5.1 tops the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index at 66 as of September 2026; available on AWS Bedrock, Google Vertex AI, and Snowflake Cortex.
strengths: Highest enterprise API adoption share at 40%
Best-in-class safety and instruction following for enterprise
Top Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index score among public APIs
Strong long-document analysis and summarization
Available across all major cloud aggregators
models.best_for: Enterprise document processing, compliance-sensitive workloads, high-stakes reasoning tasks

models.name: Gemini 2.5 Pro
models.popularity_notes: Grew web visits 450% YoY to 2.9 billion monthly in May 2026, capturing 27.9% of global AI chatbot traffic, and benefits from deep native integration across Google Vertex AI, Workspace, and Android ecosystems, giving it unmatched distribution reach.
strengths: Longest context window among closed frontier models (1M tokens)
Fastest consumer-facing growth at 450% YoY
Native multimodal capabilities across text, image, audio, video
Deep Google Workspace and Cloud integration
Strong coding and reasoning benchmark scores
models.best_for: Long-context document analysis, multimodal applications, Google Cloud-native enterprise deployments

models.name: Llama 4
models.popularity_notes: The leading open-weight model for general reasoning per multiple 2026 rankings, with massive HuggingFace download counts and broad availability on AWS Bedrock, Azure AI, Google Vertex AI, IBM watsonx, and Snowflake Cortex, making it the default self-hosted enterprise baseline globally.
strengths: Broadest aggregator coverage of any open-weight model
Zero licensing cost for self-hosted deployment
Strong general reasoning and instruction following
Huge community ecosystem and fine-tuning resources
Preferred baseline for enterprise on-premise deployments
models.best_for: Self-hosted enterprise AI, fine-tuned vertical applications, cost-sensitive high-volume inference

models.name: DeepSeek V4-Pro
models.popularity_notes: Holds 4.1% of global AI chatbot web-visit share as of May 2026 and its April 2026 release features a 1.6-trillion-parameter MoE architecture with a 1M-token context window; on OpenRouter it captures 24.4% of text API requests, reflecting massive developer adoption as a cost-efficient frontier alternative.
strengths: Highest open-source benchmark scores on SWE-Bench Verified (~80%)
Extremely low cost-per-token versus closed competitors
1.6T parameter MoE with efficient inference via sparse activation
Strong coding, math, and reasoning performance
Top open-source API marketplace share on OpenRouter
models.best_for: Cost-efficient coding assistants, high-volume API inference, open-source frontier applications

models.name: Grok-3
models.popularity_notes: Holds 2.4% of global AI chatbot web-visit share in May 2026 and benefits from exclusive integration with X (Twitter) platform giving it real-time social data access unavailable to competitors, placing it consistently in top-5 LLM rankings across Exploding Topics and Zapier surveys.
strengths: Real-time information access via X platform integration
Strong STEM and scientific reasoning capabilities
Competitive benchmark performance on math and coding
Unique social media data grounding
Tiered model family for different cost-performance tradeoffs
models.best_for: Real-time information tasks, social media analytics, STEM research assistance

models.name: Qwen3 / Qwen3-235B-A22B
models.popularity_notes: Adopted by over 90,000 enterprises per Shakudo research, leads HuggingFace open-weight download charts in Asia-Pacific, and the 235B-A22B-Thinking variant has redefined the open-weights landscape with frontier-level coding performance; Qwen2.5 named top multilingual LLM across multiple 2026 rankings.
strengths: Over 90,000 enterprise adoptions globally
Best multilingual performance among open-weight models
Massive 235B parameter variant for frontier-level tasks
Strong real-world coding benchmark results
Hybrid reasoning mode with thinking/non-thinking toggle
models.best_for: Multilingual enterprise applications, Asia-Pacific deployments, self-hosted coding and reasoning

models.name: Mistral Large
models.popularity_notes: Consistently ranked among top open-weight models for speed and efficiency in 2026 surveys, available on AWS Bedrock, Azure AI, and Google Vertex AI, and widely used by European enterprises seeking EU-based AI compliance with GDPR-friendly deployment options.
strengths: Best inference speed-to-quality ratio among frontier-class models
EU-based provider with GDPR-native compliance
Available on AWS Bedrock, Azure, and Vertex AI
Strong function-calling and agentic task performance
Smaller open-weight variants (Mistral 7B) for edge deployment
models.best_for: Latency-sensitive European enterprise applications, agentic pipelines, GDPR-compliant deployments

models.name: Perplexity Sonar
models.popularity_notes: Holds 1.3% of global AI chatbot web-visit share in May 2026 with a differentiated real-time web-search-augmented API that has driven significant developer adoption for retrieval-augmented generation use cases, with Sonar Pro widely used via the Perplexity API as a grounded reasoning layer.
strengths: Native real-time web search grounding in every API call
Strong citation and source attribution out-of-the-box
Cost-efficient for retrieval-augmented generation pipelines
Fast response times for search-integrated queries
Growing developer API ecosystem
models.best_for: Real-time research tools, RAG applications, fact-grounded content generation

models.name: Microsoft Phi-4
models.popularity_notes: Named a top LLM for high-performance reasoning in small-scale deployments across multiple 2026 rankings, widely available on Azure AI and integrated into Microsoft Copilot infrastructure, giving it significant enterprise reach through the world's largest enterprise software ecosystem.
strengths: State-of-the-art reasoning performance at small model size
Extremely low inference cost for high-volume applications
Deep integration with Azure AI and Microsoft Copilot stack
Available on HuggingFace with strong community adoption
Ideal for on-device and edge deployment scenarios
models.best_for: Edge deployment, cost-sensitive enterprise reasoning tasks, Microsoft ecosystem integrations
